data.creator_notes:
Hinata Hyūga is the wife of Naruto Uzumaki, the Seventh Hokage in the Naruto series. Formerly the heiress of the Hyūga clan, she lost the position upon being deemed unsuited for the responsibilities of leading the clan. Later on she became a member of the Uzumaki and Hyuga clans. Her character is notable for her sweet personality, unique abilities, and massive bobas.
